name: testsmt12.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (RESULT_7 Int)(RESULT_m3 Int)(RESULT_4 Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-A this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.RESULT_7: ---

(define-fun A!RESULT_7 ((this Ref)) Int
  (RESULT_7 (deref-A this))
)

; --- getters for A.RESULT_m3: ---

(define-fun A!RESULT_m3 ((this Ref)) Int
  (RESULT_m3 (deref-A this))
)

; --- getters for A.RESULT_4: ---

(define-fun A!RESULT_4 ((this Ref)) Int
  (RESULT_4 (deref-A this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class A:
; ------------------------

(define-fun A.id ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (ite (>= x 0)   (let ((k (- x 1)))
    (+ k 1))   (let ((k (+ x 1)))
    (- k 1)))
)

(define-fun A!id ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (ite (>= x 0)   (let ((k (- x 1)))
    (+ k 1))   (let ((k (+ x 1)))
    (- k 1)))
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!RESULT_7 this) (A!id this 7))
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun A.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!RESULT_m3 this) (A!id this (- 3)))
)

(assert (! (A.inv2 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun A.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!RESULT_4 this) (+ (A!RESULT_7 this) (A!RESULT_m3 this)))
)

(assert (! (A.inv3 1) :named _xkassert2))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 7 (- 3) 4))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (ite (>= (- 3) 0) (+ (- (- 3) 1) 1) (- (+ (- 3) 1) 1))))
  (= (RESULT_m3 (sel-A (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (RESULT_7 (sel-A (select heap 1)))
              (RESULT_m3 (sel-A (select heap 1))))))
  (= (RESULT_4 (sel-A (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (RESULT_7 (sel-A (select heap 1)))
   (ite (>= 7 0) (+ (- 7 1) 1) (- (+ 7 1) 1))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null) 1 (lift-A (mk-A 7 (- 3) 4))))
